page.content:
Space-ranger figure who thinks he is real — then becomes a toy.

How Buzz Lightyear connects

  • Work: Toy Story — Toy Story is the film that introduces Buzz to Andy's room.
  • Faction: Andy's toys — Buzz becomes one of Andy's toys.
  • Character: Woody — Woody and Buzz become partners after the rivalry.

What is Buzz Lightyear?

Buzz Lightyear is the deluded action figure who becomes Woody's rival and then his partner, the other half of Toy Story's pair.

Key threads lead to Toy Story, Andy's toys and Woody.
